We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity. Title: Senior AI Engineer / Data Engineer
Description: STAND 8 provides end-to-end IT solutions to enterprise partners across the United States and with offices in Los Angeles, New York, New Jersey, Atlanta, and more including internationally in Mexico and India. We are building AI-powered products that are transforming how enterprises manage talent acquisition and workforce operations. Our flagship platform processes millions of records, orchestrates multi-model AI pipelines, and delivers real-time intelligence across voice, text, and structured data channels. This is a platform engineering role. You will build production-grade APIs, data pipelines, and AI systems that enterprise clients depend on daily. The work spans bidirectional CRM syncs processing hundreds of thousands of records, real-time data enrichment pipelines, document intelligence systems, and AI-powered voice interactions at scale. We are looking for software engineers who build production systems and have applied AI/ML as part of that work. You should be someone who thinks about API contracts, error handling, data integrity, and system reliability instinctively, and brings that engineering discipline to everything you build, including AI-powered features. If your first question about a new feature is "how does the data flow end to end and what happens when something fails," this role is for you. You will work directly with platform leadership and collaborate with a distributed team across the US, India, and Mexico. For Mexico-based candidates, this role is a foundational hire for our AI Center of Excellence in Mexico, with the opportunity to help shape and grow the team. Required Qualifications Core Engineering Foundation (Non-Negotiable) 5+ years Python in production environments with a track record of shipping software that real users and systems depend on. Not notebooks, not prototypes. Strong API development: Deep experience building production APIs with FastAPI, Django, or equivalent. Must understand API design patterns, async request handling, middleware, dependency injection, authentication, rate limiting, background tasks, error handling, and versioning. This is a core daily activity, not a secondary skill. Data pipeline architecture: Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines, bidirectional data syncs, data transformation layers, and enrichment workflows. Must understand data integrity, idempotency, failure recovery, backpressure, and pipeline observability. Experience with batch and real-time processing patterns. Production database expertise: Strong PostgreSQL (or equivalent) skills including schema design, query optimization, migrations, indexing strategies, and working with large datasets (1M+ records). Understands when to use relational vs. document vs. vector storage. Async Python and concurrency: Strong understanding of asyncio, concurrent processing patterns, and event-driven architectures. Must be comfortable with SQS/queue-based processing, background workers, and managing concurrent API calls to external services. AI/ML Systems (Non-Negotiable) Production LLM integration: Must have built and shipped systems using OpenAI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock APIs. Should be able to discuss prompt engineering, structured outputs, function calling/tool use, token optimization, and error handling patterns. Agentic AI and tool use: Experience building AI systems that make autonomous decisions, call external tools, and chain multi-step reasoning. Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, or custom implementations). Understanding of planning patterns, guardrails, and when to use agents vs. deterministic pipelines. AI evaluation and testing: Experience building evaluation frameworks for non-deterministic AI systems. Should understand how to measure output quality systematically: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge patterns, regression testing, and behavioral monitoring in production. This is how you know your AI systems are actually working. RAG and retrieval systems: Hands-on experience building retrieval-augmented generation pipelines. Must understand chunking strategies, embedding models, hybrid retrieval (vector + keyword), reranking, and relevance evaluation. Vector database expertise: Production experience with at least one of PostgreSQL/PGVector, Weaviate, FAISS, Pinecone, or Qdrant. Should be able to discuss indexing strategies, approximate nearest neighbor tradeoffs, and performance optimization. Infrastructure & DevOps AWS cloud services: Working experience with core AWS services (ECS/Fargate, Lambda, RDS, S3, SQS, CloudWatch). Should understand serverless patterns, container orchestration, and cloud cost management. Docker and containerization: Production deployment experience with container orchestration, health checks, and resource management. Observability and LLMOps: Experience with logging, monitoring, alerting, and debugging distributed systems in production. For AI systems specifically: tracing agent runs, monitoring LLM call quality and latency, detecting behavioral drift, and debugging non-deterministic failures. Git workflows and CI/CD: Collaborative development with branching strategies, code reviews, and automated deployment pipelines. Preferred Qualifications Software engineering foundation: Background in building APIs, web applications, or backend services. Engineers who picked up data pipeline and AI/ML skills because the product demanded it, rather than coming from a pure research or data science background. This trajectory is strongly preferred. Third-party API integration experience: Track record of integrating complex external APIs (CRMs, enrichment services, telephony providers, payment systems). Understands OAuth flows, webhook handling, rate limit management, and graceful degradation when third-party services fail. ATS/HR tech background: Experience with Bullhorn, Greenhouse, Workday, or similar platforms. Understanding of candidate lifecycle, matching algorithms, and recruiting workflows. Voice AI systems: Experience with ElevenLabs, OpenAI Realtime API, WebRTC, SIP/telephony integration, or speech synthesis pipelines. MCP (Model Context Protocol): Experience building or consuming MCP servers for agent tooling and context management. AI coding tools proficiency: Active use of Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar AI-assisted development tools in daily workflow. Guardrails and AI safety: Experience implementing input/output validation layers, PII/sensitive data filtering, prompt injection defense, and content safety checks for production AI systems. Familiarity with tools like Guardrails AI or Nemo Guardrails. Multi-model architecture: Experience working with multiple LLM providers and understanding when to use which model for cost, latency, and quality tradeoffs. Knowledge graphs: Experience with Neo4j or similar graph databases for relationship-based data modeling and traversal. Cost optimization at scale: Track record of optimizing LLM token usage, caching strategies, and multi-provider routing to reduce AI infrastructure costs. Large-scale data processing: Experience processing 1M+ records with performance optimization, failure handling, and data quality validation at scale. Title: Sr Business Process Engineer
Description: Insulet started in 2000 with an idea and a mission to enable our customers to enjoy simplicity, freedom and healthier lives through the use of our Omnipod® product platform. In the last two decades we have improved the lives of hundreds of thousands of patients by using innovative technology that is wearable, waterproof, and lifestyle accommodating. We are looking for highly motivated, performance driven individuals to be a part of our expanding team. We do this by hiring amazing people guided by shared values who exceed customer expectations. Our continued success depends on it! Insulet is building an exciting greenfield business services organization, with a major hub in Guadalajara. We are implementing a full range of services across Finance, HR, Procurement, IT, and other service areas. We are seeking an analytical Senior Business Process Engineer , with a strong background in service operations, computer science and/or consulting. The role will work as part of our Business Transformation and CX team, supporting initiatives across all functions. This role will be the business owner for our process quality tools and methods, supporting new service onboarding and the continuous improvement of live services. The person will work alongside the relevant transformation and operational teams to optimize performance, enhance automation, and enable scalable, efficient operations. It will require the person to develop a deep (expert) understanding of process modelling (we use ADONIS), KPI dashboarding (we use Power BI), process automation, and service onboarding (we have developed our own methodology for use in Insulet). You will have plenty of opportunities to experiment with the best ways of working, set standards, and develop skills. This role will suit someone that is ambitious to develop expertise in how to operate services in a high end multi-functional global business services environment. Main Responsibilities Own IGBS KPI dashboards Be the primary source of expertise in IGBS for KPIs and dashboard building. Teaching the rest of the organization how to develop great KPIs and how to get value from them. Build and maintain all IGBS KPI dashboards in Power BI. We expect to have a dashboard for each service that we build – currently we have four dashboards. Take a strong interest in the best way to present KPIs, designing and visualizing the data to help users understand trends and insights. Share those dashboards with leadership and service delivery teams, helping them to understand the data and use it to drive operational improvements. Manage user access to dashboards. Manage data sources Work with functions, business transformation colleagues, and IT to identify and source data. Be accountable for the accuracy and quality of the data and KPIs that you upload and present. Acquire (and chase if required) master datasets regularly (monthly / weekly) and use it to update the dashboards with current data. Create and edit Power Queries within Power BI to clean and transform data for use. Manually clean and transform data as required before copying to Master datasets. Back-up all master datasets. Run manual data acquisition (e.g. surveys) for data that require them – e.g. CSAT feedback. Automate data uploads where possible. Maintain immaculate record keeping on the sources of data, the calculations used to create KPIs, the steps required to maintain master data sets, and the organization of those master data sets. Present those records transparently for dashboard users and be ‘always ready for inspection’. Own the IGBS approach to process modeling Develop a strong expertise in process modeling, acting as a teacher and role model for the whole IGBS organization, especially colleagues in Business Transformation and CX. Own and develop the IGBS process modeling standards and toolset (ADONIS). Promote the use of the standards and toolset across IGBS, and other parts of Insulet where required. Train new users (Editors, Reviewers, and Readers). Be the systems administrator for ADONIS, creating accounts, adjusting permissions, monitoring licenses, and requesting changes when required. Be the primary point of interface for BOC, the provider of ADONIS. Perform a standards review for all IGBS process maps, coaching users to improve the quality of their process mapping. Innovate our process capabilities Develop approaches to process data mining, making the case for those approaches in the IGBS toolset. Develop approaches to process automation, working with IT and Business Transformation colleagues. Maintain our service onboarding methodology We have developed our own service onboarding methodology. This is used for each new service that we introduce to IGBS. We review and update it annually. Own the review and update process, maintaining great methodology records in the process. Education And Experience Bachelor’s degree in an analytical subject, such as Business, Process Management, Data and Analytics, Operations, Computer Science. 6-8 years of experience in a relevant environment. These include: management consulting, operations consulting, service management, process management, operational delivery. A genuine interest in and understanding of data visualization and process modeling Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, communication and stakeholder engagement abilities Preferred Skills And Competencies Proficiency in Data analysis tools (e.g., Power BI, SQL, Python, Tableau, Power Point, Project and Excel).
